models.notes: Emits scripted partial/final messages from a fixed script with no audio decoding at all. It exists so the whole C++ side - handshake, session lifetime, seq ordering, stable_bytes monotonicity, commit engine, injection, overlay - can be exercised end to end without a GPU, and so that a failure is attributable to the C++ side rather than to a model. It also drives the deliberate protocol violations the fixtures require (a decreasing stable_bytes, a mutated stable prefix), which no real backend will produce on demand. This is the default because it is the only entry whose environment costs nothing to create: the backend is stdlib-only, so it points straight at the system interpreter and needs no venv at all.

Phase 0A pick 1 - the streaming finalist candidate (bench/CANDIDATES.md section 4, row A'). No PyTorch. The published ONNX export is distributed as one repository per chunk size, which maps one-to-one onto the chunk_ms sweep in plan.md section 4; add a separate entry per chunk size rather than making chunk size a runtime setting, because the weights differ. Cannot be context-biased: greedy_search only (CANDIDATES.md section 5.1), so it must report context_supported:false in `ready` rather than silently ignoring start.context.

Phase 0A pick 2 (row B'). Same adapter as the entry above, one model swap. Adds the 320 ms configuration that the English-only model's 160/560 gap does not cover. Kept as a variant, not a separate workstream: if it is not measurably better on the technical corpus, delete this entry.

Phase 0A pick 3 (row C) - the context-biasing arm, and the ONLY natively-streaming candidate that supports vocabulary biasing (transducer hotwords, which require modified_beam_search rather than greedy_search). plan.md section 4 requires context-enabled and context-free modes to be compared separately; without this entry the context-enabled column has no native-streaming entrant at all. Expected to lose on raw WER - that is the point: it measures what biasing is worth.

Phase 0A pick 4 (row D) - the accuracy baseline, zero install. READ-ONLY VENV: plan.md section 5.1 and CANDIDATES.md are explicit that D:\projects\wan-dancer\.venv belongs to another project and that NOTHING may be installed into it - not faster-whisper, not NeMo, not an 'obviously compatible' pin, not under a --dry-run justification. This entry only runs the interpreter that is already there. Pseudo-streaming, so per plan.md its latency numbers are not comparable with the native-streaming rows and must be reported in a separate block. HF_HOME is already set globally on this machine; it is repeated here so the child does not depend on the parent's environment happening to carry it.
